decision_conditions: The proposed development would provide a substandard and unsatisfactory internal living environment for future occupiers by reason of the limited and inadequate communal accommodation proposed, including the absence of sufficient internal communal living or recreational space. The proposal would therefore fail to provide a comfortable, functional and fit-for-purpose living environment for future occupiers, contrary to Policies D3 and D6 of the London Plan (2021), and Policies DMH 5 and DMHB 16 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part Two (2020).

The proposed change of use from a dwellinghouse (Use Class C3) to a four-bedroom House in Multiple Occupation (Use Class C4) would result in an over-intensive form of occupation that would materially increase levels of activity, comings and goings, noise and disturbance, to the detriment of the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and the established residential character of the area. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Policy EM8 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part One (2012), Policies DMH 5, DMHB 11 and DMHD 1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part Two (2020), Policies D3 and D14 of the London Plan (2021), and paragraph 135(f) of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).

The intensified nature of the proposed House in Multiple Occupation use, including the increased residential and servicing activity associated with occupation by multiple unrelated individuals, would be out of keeping with the established character of the area, which is predominantly characterised by single family occupation. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Policy BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part One (2012), Policies DMHB 11 and DMHD 1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part Two (2020), and Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021).

The decision to REFUSE planning permission has been taken having regard to all relevant planning legislation, regulations, guidance, circulars and Council policies, including The Human Rights Act (1998) (HRA 1998) which makes it unlawful for the Council to act incompatibly with Convention rights, specifically Article 6 (right to a fair hearing); Article 8 (right to respect for private and family life); Article 1 of the First Protocol (protection of property) and Article 14 (prohibition of discrimination).

The decision to REFUSE planning permission has been taken having regard to the policies and proposals in the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012) and Part 2 (2020) set out below, including Supplementary Planning Guidance, and to all relevant material considerations, including The London Plan (2021) and national guidance.
description: Change of use from dwellinghouse (Class C3) to small House in Multiple Occupation (Class C4), including conversion of garage space to habitable space and amendments to fenestration.
